Meet the Visionary

Apostle Denise J. Daniels

Her walk with Christ began in 1988 when she surrendered her life fully to the Lord, setting her feet on a path that would shape her calling for decades to come. She faithfully served at New Life Tabernacle for 12 years, growing in ministry through preaching, evangelism, and pastoral care. In 2000, she joined Elim International Fellowship under the leadership of the late Archbishop Wilbert S. McKinley, where she was ordained as an Elder and served as Associate Pastor, Youth Pastor, and Canon of the church. Her ministry soon reached international platforms—preaching in Lagos, Nigeria in 2003 and appearing on the Trinity Broadcasting Network in 2005.

In 2020, she founded Denise J. Daniels Ministries as a source of prayer, discipleship, and deliverance during a season of global challenge. That vision has now advanced into Kingdom Culture Global Ministries—a movement committed to raising Kingdom-minded believers who carry God’s presence into every sphere of life and impact nations for His glory.

Apostle Denise J. Daniels is an apostolic and prophetic voice to the nations, carrying a Kingdom mandate to equip, train, disciple, and empower believers to operate in Kingdom dominion across all mountains of influence. Born and raised in Brooklyn, New York, she carries the strength, resilience, and passion of her hometown into every assignment.

Beyond the pulpit, Apostle Denise treasures her role as a mother and grandmother, drawing wisdom, compassion, and understanding from her own life’s journey. Her story is more than a record of accomplishments; it is a living testimony of the transformative power of the Lord Jesus Christ.

Ministry Request

“Until the Kingdom of God is established in every sphere…”

Our Mission

Advancing the Kingdom of God across every domain of society.

Kingdom Culture Global Ministries exists to advance the Kingdom of God by equipping and commissioning believers to:

  • Govern in the spirit and build according to divine blueprints
  • Manifest Kingdom principles through righteous living and spiritual authority
  • Restore and operate in the fivefold ministry as outlined in Ephesians 4:11–13
  • Engage in intentional apostolic communities that disciple, train, send, and lead
  • Teach and model the culture, economy, and government of the Kingdom of God
  • Affirm the authority of Scripture and uphold sacred ordinances
  • Operate in spiritual gifts and practice spiritual warfare through prayer and intercession
  • Live in anticipation of Christ’s return, while establishing righteousness, justice, and influence in every domain of society

Together, we establish a global movement of transformation.

One life, one community, and one nation at a time.

Become a Partner

Give a Donation

Kingdom Partnership with Purpose

As a donor or partner, you are not merely giving—you are co-laboring in Kingdom expansion. Your partnership fuels initiatives that transform communities, empower believers, and advance the message of Christ across nations through outreach, education, and media.

Privacy & Protection

As a 508(c)(1)(a), we operate under First Amendment religious protections, not under public charity mandates—ensuring your giving remains sacred, secure, and confidential.

Eternal Impact & Kingdom Alignment

Each seed sown into Kingdom Culture Global Ministries has eternal significance—advancing the Gospel, developing leaders, and impacting generations with the transforming power of faith.

Exclusive Partner Engagement

As a valued Covenant Partner, you’ll receive personal invitations to worship gatherings and leadership events, regular impact updates, and priority involvement in ministry initiatives and mission trips.

Transforming Communities Together

Your contributions directly support programs that uplift lives and communities:

  • Faith-based education & discipleship
  • Humanitarian missions and global outreach
  • Youth empowerment & leadership training
  • Media & broadcasting that share the Gospel worldwide
  • Community development & transformation projects

Spiritual Fulfillment & Legacy

Giving is more than a transaction—it is an act of worship and faith. Your generosity releases Kingdom blessings, creates legacy, and aligns your resources with divine purpose.

Kingdom Culture Global Ministries—A 508(c)(1)(a) Faith-Based Organization allowing all donations and contributions to be fully tax-deductible under the law.

Education & Empowerment

Until the Kingdom of God is established in every sphere.

You’re invited to become part of a growing faith-based education, discipleship, and empowerment community designed to strengthen your spiritual walk and equip you for purposeful living.

Join us to receive sound biblical teaching, meaningful mentorship, and engaging Bible-based classes in an environment that encourages growth, accountability, and transformation.

Come learn, grow, and be empowered — your next level of faith and purpose starts here.
